hero.quote: Get a quote for a content engine
hero.title: AI content generator for LinkedIn
hero.subtitle: This is the tool KopTup uses to prepare posts about its own demos: a 30-day editorial plan, posts, ad copy, carousels and images. It does not post to LinkedIn: you copy the text and publish it yourself.
hero.forWho: B2B marketing teams and agencies that post on LinkedIn consistently: this is how an AI content engine built around your own catalog would work.

chips.capture: Images, photo and video of each demo

badges.sampleDataHint: The calendar, the templates and the previews are sample content; “Generate with AI” does call a real model.

overview.firstStepsDesc: Three steps to go from an idea to a post ready for LinkedIn. Each one is checked off as you do it.

calendar.title: Pick a day from the plan
calendar.desc: A different demo every day, with a suggested angle and format. Click a day and the generator loads that setup.

generator.title: Generate and review the post
generator.desc: With AI or with templates: hook, body, call to action and hashtags, plus ad copy and a carousel. Copy it or save it as a draft.

capture.title: Add the visual
capture.desc: Create a 1200×627 image from templates or take a photo or video of the demo; use it in the preview or download it.

0.label: Pick the day:
0.text: open the calendar and click the day; the demo and the angle are sent to the generator.

1.label: Generate and adjust:
1.text: generate with AI or with templates, try another version or change the tone, and edit what only you can add.

2.label: Check the facts:
2.text: review the alerts (unsourced figures, testimonials, links without UTM) and save the draft.

3.label: Create the visual:
3.text: download a 1200×627 template or capture the demo and use it in the preview.

4.label: Publish it yourself:
4.text: copy the text, upload the image or video to LinkedIn and post from your account. If you want paid reach, use the “Ad copy” view in the generator.

overview.scopeTitle: What this demo does and does not do

does.0: Generates the post, ad copy and a carousel with AI (an OpenAI model called from KopTup's server, with a usage quota) or, when AI is not available, with local templates, and tells you which one it used.
does.1: Lets you edit the text, checks it for accuracy alerts, saves drafts in this browser and exports them to CSV.
does.2: Creates 1200×627 images from templates, downloads the carousel as a PDF and takes a photo or video of the KopTup demos you can open.
does.3: Adds UTM parameters to links so you can measure visits in your analytics.

doesNot.0: It does not connect to your LinkedIn account or post for you. In a custom project it can connect to the LinkedIn API if your company has approved access.
doesNot.1: It does not measure reach, clicks or followers: the preview shows no real reactions.
doesNot.2: It does not make up results: the texts include no client figures or testimonials; if you add a figure, it needs a source.

chatbot.descripcion: An assistant that answers only from your documents and cites the source of each answer
funciones: Try it with a sample document or your own (PDF, DOCX or TXT)
Cites the page or passage behind each answer
Says “not found” when the answer is not in the documents
Set up your own assistant with its website widget
chatbot.problema: Teams lose hours answering the same questions and many chatbots answer without a source to back them up

ecommerce.descripcion: A sample store for Colombia, from purchase to shipping and reports
funciones: Catalog, cart with coupons and simulated payment (card, PSE, Nequi or cash on delivery)
The order shows up in the store's admin panel
Simulated shipping label and tracking, with returns
Sales reports you can export to CSV
ecommerce.problema: Many online stores show the same catalog to everyone and do not guide the purchase

dashboard-ejecutivo.descripcion: A management dashboard for a fictitious company, with figures that match across views
funciones: Sales versus target, margin and income statement
Receivables aging and 13-week cash flow
Rule-based alerts and guided questions
PDF report and your own sales CSV loaded in the browser
dashboard-ejecutivo.problema: Reports arrive late, in spreadsheets, and do not explain what changed

gestor-documentos.descripcion: Organize, search and summarize company documents
funciones: A construction company's sample archive with folders, search and trash
Clause detection in contracts
Signed in, you upload your PDF, DOCX, TXT or CSV files and AI summarizes and tags them
Search by meaning and “Explain with AI”
gestor-documentos.problema: Documents sit in folders nobody reviews until an audit comes

sistema-reservas.descripcion: Online bookings for clinics, spas and sports courts, with the business schedule
funciones: The customer picks a location, service, professional and a free slot
Simulated deposit and confirmation with a WhatsApp and email preview
Schedule by professional to confirm, reschedule and mark attendance
Exports the schedule to .ics and the list to CSV
sistema-reservas.problema: Appointments get lost because the schedule lives in a notebook or in scattered chats

gestor-contenido.descripcion: Content for web, app and assistant, from draft to publication
funciones: Content types with web and app preview
AI text improvements
Review, approval and scheduled publishing with roles
Delivery through a JSON API and webhooks to notify channels
gestor-contenido.problema: Writing emails, announcements and proposals takes longer than it should

control-proyectos.descripcion: Client projects with progress the client can see
funciones: Board, list, calendar and timeline with dependencies
Hours and budget per milestone
Portal where the client sees progress and approves deliverables
Construction, creative agency and software examples
control-proyectos.problema: Projects fall behind and nobody sees the warning signs in time

crm-ia.descripcion: A B2B sales pipeline with each lead score explained
funciones: Drag-and-drop sales pipeline
Each lead score explained factor by factor
Forecast in pesos versus target
WhatsApp and email drafts and a follow-up sequence
crm-ia.problema: Salespeople forget follow-ups and spend time on deals that are not moving

erp.descripcion: Sales, inventory, purchasing, accounting and more, all connected
funciones: An invoice reduces inventory, posts its journal entry and goes to receivables
Purchasing with approvals
Accounting with the Colombian chart of accounts, treasury and receivables
HR and production
erp.problema: The company runs several systems that do not talk to each other

helpdesk-ia.descripcion: One inbox for every support channel, with AI-drafted replies
funciones: Single inbox for email, chat, WhatsApp and calls (simulated)
Rule-based automatic classification and assignment
AI-drafted reply that cites the knowledge base
SLA, surveys and complaints tracked in Colombian business days
helpdesk-ia.problema: The support team solves the same requests every day

lms.descripcion: Online courses with an AI tutor and verifiable certificates
funciones: Course catalog and simulated checkout
Lessons with an AI tutor that cites the lesson
Final exam and adaptive path
Certificates with a verifiable QR code
lms.problema: Internal courses get abandoned because they are long and generic

telemedicina.descripcion: A provider's day: scheduling, virtual visit and billing
funciones: The patient books and fills in the pre-visit form with consents
Virtual office with a waiting room and simulated video visit
Prescription and visit notes
Simulated billing and health-services report
telemedicina.problema: Patients in remote areas wait a long time to see a specialist

funciones: Invoices, credit and debit notes and POS equivalent document
Validates the tax ID check digit and computes VAT and withholdings
Sample PDF with QR code and XML
Sample RADIAN events and period ledgers
facturacion-electronica.problema: A badly issued e-invoice leads to rejections and rework

wms-logistica.descripcion: A logistics operator's flow, from receiving to delivery
funciones: Receiving with scanning and rule-based put-away
Order waves with stock reserved by expiry date
Picking, packing and shipping label as PDF
Delivery with signature and tracking
wms-logistica.problema: Warehouse staff waste time looking for products without a clear location

pos.descripcion: The register of a mini-market and a restaurant
funciones: Selling with a barcode scanner and scale
Tables and kitchen tickets
Split payment and sample POS equivalent document
Offline sales and register closing
pos.problema: The register is not connected to inventory and closings are done by hand

hrms.descripcion: Records, vacations, recruiting and Colombian payroll in one place
funciones: Digital employee records and vacations in business days
Recruiting with rule-based scoring
Biweekly payroll with contributions and provisions
Employee app with an assistant that answers from the handbook
hrms.problema: The HR team lives between spreadsheets and forms

automatizacion.descripcion: A workflow editor to automate repetitive tasks
funciones: Sample flows: supplier invoices, collections and leads
Step-by-step runs with input and output data
Editor to add and configure steps
Versions, templates and cases to review

saas-boilerplate.descripcion: How your software would look sold by subscription
funciones: Customer sign-up with isolated data
Simulated subscription billing
Teams, roles and support access
Audit log, webhooks and test API
publico: Teams launching a minimum viable product

voice-ai.descripcion: How a voice agent would answer the phone, in sample calls
funciones: Sample banking, healthcare, collections and ordering calls
Transcript with sensitive data masked
Intent, sentiment and agent actions
Handoff to a human agent with context

firma-electronica.descripcion: Signing envelopes with verifiable evidence, from template to signature

Signer view with a verification code
Evidence with a verifiable hash chain
Metrics for the sample envelopes

scraping.descripcion: Monitoring of public sources: prices, procurement and regulations
funciones: Extractor built with clicks
What changed since yesterday
Configurable alerts
Data downloads and a legal sheet for each source
scraping.problema: Companies learn too late about price and catalog changes in their market

code-review-ia.descripcion: Automatic pull request review with comments on the code
funciones: Score and risk for each pull request
Comments anchored to the change, with suggestions
Security findings and vulnerable dependencies
Review your own diff with local rules
code-review-ia.problema: Code changes wait days for a review

moderacion-contenido.descripcion: A platform's moderation console, with rules you adjust
funciones: Sample cases classified with their explanation
Threshold rules that decide each case's route
Simulator with a sample batch
Human review for borderline cases
moderacion-contenido.problema: Offensive content and spam in a community hurt the brand

delivery.descripcion: A restaurant's own delivery channel, in four connected apps
funciones: Customer app to order and pay
Store app to accept and prepare
Operations assigns couriers and watches times
The courier delivers with a code
delivery.problema: Couriers drive inefficient routes and customers do not know where their order is

loyalty.descripcion: A retail chain's points club, from the register to the results
funciones: Sign-up and points at the register
Member app to redeem
Rules, tiers, missions and campaigns
Results and points liability
loyalty.problema: Points programs are boring and almost nobody redeems their rewards
